public.text: The term "layered" is reused here for regional-vs-national governance ("Layered governance," 511) after 3.4.5 already established "layers" to mean governance/runtime/content (419–431). The same word now denotes two unrelated structures within a few pages of each other.
public.suggestedRevision: Use a distinct term for the regional/national split (e.g. "tiered governance" or "governance scope split") to avoid conflating it with the governance/runtime/content layering in 3.4.5.
